sloka: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवानां विष्णुरब्रवीत् ।मामेव यजतां शक्रः पावयिष्यामि वज्रिणम् ।। ७.८५.२० ॥
transliteration: teṣāṁ tadvacanaṁ śrutvā devānāṁ viṣṇurabravīt ।māmeva yajatāṁ śakraḥ pāvayiṣyāmi vajriṇam ।। 7.85.20 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of the gods, Vishnu said, "Let Indra worship me alone, and I shall purify the wielder of the thunderbolt."
